name: ux
works_with: Coding agents working in the LobeHub codebase
short: LobeHub's own UX checklists for empty, loading and error states, lists at scale, drafts and buttons, for building its screens.
what: This is the skill LobeHub uses when building or reviewing user-facing flows in its own app. It covers four design values, a few interaction principles and checklists grouped by what the user is doing: reading, editing, acting, waiting on feedback and discovering features. It points to LobeHub components such as `NavItem` and its `DESIGN.md`.
who: People contributing to LobeHub. Anyone else can read the checklists for ideas, but much of it refers to LobeHub's own components and files.
needs: Git and pnpm, to clone LobeHub for local development
A coding agent that reads skills

steps.title: Clone LobeHub
steps.text: These are the README's local development steps. The skill lives in the repo at `.agents/skills/ux`.
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub.git
cd lobehub
pnpm install

steps.title: Work on a screen
steps.text: The skill isn't called by name. It applies when your agent designs or builds a user-facing flow. Start with its quick review checklist, then read the module for the surface you're on.

try.label: A first prompt
try.where: Your coding agent, in the LobeHub repo
try.text: "Review this list page against the ux skill's Read checklist."

watch: The README gives no install command for the skill on its own. It comes with the LobeHub repo.
It assumes LobeHub's components and `DESIGN.md`, so outside that codebase parts of it won't apply.
